definition: Years from interconnection-request (queue) date to in-service date for OPERATIONAL generation/storage requests that have both dates; 48 requests with impossible date order excluded; conditioned on reaching commercial operation (survivorship). NOT a time-to-power for a load and NOT a data-centre connection time.

provenance.workbook: Queued Up 2026 Edition data file lbnl_ix_queue_data_file_thru2025.xlsx, sheet '03. Complete Queue Data' (data through end of 2025)
provenance.parser: gridforge_stress.queue.duration_summary (population 'operational'); computed in memory in CI; no row-level data stored here
provenance.cross_check: the harness's date/percentile arithmetic reproduces LBNL's published sheet-37 medians to 0.005 months where sample sizes are equal (run 40640016068); LBNL's own sample is the any-status population, which differs slightly from this operational-only one

limits: US interconnection queues for generation/storage, not load interconnections

Survivorship: only requests that reached commercial operation are included; most requests in the dataset did not (the dataset records 24,221 withdrawn and 4,789 operational requests across all years); see the survivorship block for cohort outcomes
A queue duration says nothing about a specific site's network operator, tariff, study status or equipment delivery
Regions are LBNL's regional groupings, not network operators

survivorship.measured_in: GitHub Actions probe run 40642980669 (same workbook sha256 as above)

any_status_cod_2018_2025.note: any-status population: requests with both dates whatever their current status (the population that reproduces LBNL's own sheet 37 best); 50 impossible-order rows excluded

survivorship.cohort_note: status as of the workbook (data through end of 2025); active/suspended/unknown requests are unresolved, not failures; later cohorts are right-censored
